Package com.patelheet.capitalengine.api

Record Class Stats

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.patelheet.capitalengine.api.Stats
Record Components:
moneySupply - every coin that exists (the Mint's balance, negated)
activeMoneySupply - moneySupply minus balances of players inactive for the dormant period
treasuryBalance - the Treasury's balance
issuedToday - coins created today
destroyedToday - coins destroyed today
treasuryInToday - coins paid into the Treasury today
treasuryOutToday - coins paid out of the Treasury today
flowsToday - today's flows by source plugin
activePlayersToday - players with at least 5 active (non-AFK) minutes today
activeMinutesToday - total active minutes today
avgActivePlayers7d - average of activePlayersToday over the last 7 days
dayIndex - current economic day
weekIndex - current economic week
public record Stats(long moneySupply, long activeMoneySupply, long treasuryBalance, long issuedToday, long destroyedToday, long treasuryInToday, long treasuryOutToday, Map<String,PluginFlow> flowsToday, int activePlayersToday, long activeMinutesToday, double avgActivePlayers7d, long dayIndex, long weekIndex) extends Record
Instant economy-wide snapshot, read from memory.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with '=='.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
